prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving game asset.
Create one independent LEFT-FACING full-body transparent asset of the exact mutated Lucas Baker boss from Resident Evil7 Biohazard (2017), Not a Hero, based on the attached original model render. This source is the authority for anatomy, edition, proportions, coloring and fixed asymmetry.
Camera geometry: move around the ORIGINAL figure to show its ANATOMICAL LEFT flank nearest the viewer, so its head and entire body face the LEFT edge of the image. The anatomical LEFT upper limb, the bulky dark mouth-bearing curled limb seen on image-RIGHT in the original frontal reference, is now NEARER the camera. The anatomical RIGHT upper limb, the massive pale long downward blade seen on source image-LEFT, remains the FAR limb. Preserve these fixed attachments. This is a real spatial turn, never a reflection or an exchange of the two arms.
Turn the clustered head, ribbed chest, central pelvis, knees and both small feet together toward image-LEFT. The thorax must be foreshortened consistently with the same leftward three-quarter angle, not a frontal chest with a turned head. Keep the head readable above the near mouth-bearing limb; keep the far pale blade and its pointed bottom visible through believable separation. Exactly two huge distinct upper arms and two supporting lower legs, all original hooked projections and dorsal spikes attached as in the source. Do not add limbs or use another Lucas form.
Maintain the supplied pale grey skeletal structures, muted dark brown/red internal material, original proportions and game-model appearance. No redesign, added gore, invented growths or effects. Neutral readable light. The entire single creature, from the uppermost dorsal spike to both complete feet and lowest blade tip, must be contained with generous transparent breathing room on all four sides. True alpha transparency, no grey/black background plate, floor, cast-shadow panel, mist, other character, label, watermark, inset, second view or animation sheet. One creature in one pose only.
